amis-titv-news.note: TITV Amis evening news - Chinese dialogue subtitle painted straight onto the footage, so the dark-outline test is required. The box is tall because the subtitle uses two heights: y=786..838 normally, and y=730..778 over letterboxed clips. It stops at y=844 on purpose - the red lower-third starts at y=846, and its Amis keyword and reporter name would otherwise be read as dialogue.

amis-xiuguluan-bilingual.note: 'a'ǔyalaeho: 開會了 - Amis over Chinese in an opaque yellow band at the foot of the frame. Because the band is a saturated colour, plain white-pixel detection is enough and the dark-outline test is not needed.

titv-news.note: TITV 族語新聞. Chinese dialogue subtitle painted onto the footage, so the dark-outline test is required. Measured row profiles agree across both deliveries: the 1080i MPEG-2 masters (2月原始mxf檔) and the h264 mp4s of every other month both put the text plateau at y=788..844 with a sharp spike at y=848 -- the top edge of the red lower-third, which carries the indigenous-language headline and interviewee name supers and must not be read as dialogue. SELECT THIS BY FOLDER, not by file name: pass `--preset titv-news` for anything under 族語新聞/. File names in this corpus are not a reliable signal (魯凱語-霧台…, 賽德克-…, 排灣-… all name the same programme), which is why `match` below only covers the mxf batch and is a convenience, not the contract.
